profile.name: Kristoffer Kelly
profile.title: Operations Manager | Process Systems | Legal & Compliance
profile.location: Las Vegas, NV | Open to remote / hybrid
profile.summary: 10+ years leading operations teams and building systems that work. I take messy, manual processes and turn them into reliable, auditable workflows. Quiet leader who listens first, moves fast, and delivers results.

velocity_metrics.label: Workflow Improvement
velocity_metrics.detail: Rebuilt a legacy legal operations process from the ground up. Cut cycle time by 93% while improving accuracy.

velocity_metrics.label: Scale & Consistency
velocity_metrics.detail: Supervised 15+ staff across regional locations. Maintained 99%+ accuracy on high-volume legal filings and compliance records.

bullets: Supervised 15+ legal staff across two regional locations. Built team from ground up and maintained consistency across both sites.
Designed and implemented SOPs that became department standard. Reduced errors and improved speed on every major workflow.
Handled all legal discovery and filing work—complaints, motions, responses, judgments. Maintained 99%+ accuracy on complex litigation documents.
Built training programs for multi-department teams. Taught 50+ staff members company-wide processes and standards.
Managed large portfolios of accounts. Ensured audit-ready records, accurate reporting, and full regulatory compliance.
Translated complex government regulations (CERS, Accela, LAFD) into workable compliance steps for the team.
Mapped site boundaries and operational requirements into system records. Built the documentation that made field work possible.
Reduced compliance errors by standardizing workflows and documentation across all projects.
